adjudication.rationale: The diff defines `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (packages/lib/constants.ts), which evaluates to a `string | undefined` (specifically the second env var’s string) and is used as a boolean gate in multiple security-sensitive paths (e.g., new webhook handler `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` and OAuth refresh helpers). Because this gate relies on implicit truthiness of env strings, any non-empty value (including whitespace or "0") will enable the feature, without any explicit boolean flag or validation of secret strength/format, which can inadvertently enable credential sharing under weak/bogus secrets.
